text:
alice: Quick sync — planning a zero-downtime swap for feature flag ff/model-v2 during the midnight change window (00:30 UTC). Need a short checklist, who will flip, and clear rollback criteria. Ping if you can't take ownership.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @alice for 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC. CI build 2026-03-22-42 passed — https://ci.internal/reports/2026-03-22-42 

ben: I can take the flip. Proposed ramp: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m. Monitor error budget, p95 latency, and a small eval set (5 quick prompts). I'll run the rollout commands.

carla: Add telemetry gates: abort if 5xx increases >1% absolute OR p95 latency regresses by >200ms sustained for 5m. Also watch model hallucination metric (new_token_F1 drop). If triggered, immediate rollback and pin to v1.

dinesh: I'll prepare a rollback playbook and pin command. Example rollback sequence: 
```
# rollback sequence
ffctl set ff/model-v2 --weight 0
ffctl pin ff/model-routing --version v1 --reason "rollback"
deploy-bot notify --tag rollback
```
I'll have it staged in /runbooks/rollbacks/ff-model-v2.md

ben: Commands I'll run for the ramp: 
```
# start canary
ffctl rollout ff/model-v2 --to=cohort:canary --weight=1 --notes "canary start"
# increment
ffctl set ff/model-v2 --weight 5 --notes "canary 5%"
```
I'll post each step here.

carla: Also enable prefix KV cache for model-v2 before 5% to avoid cold-start tail latency: infra toggle kvcache/model-v2 on. Make sure cache warmup jobs run.

alice: Note the change window: do not perform other infra changes during ramp. If component-A latency regresses >10% for >5m, abort. I'll write a short release note once we hit 100%.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp started at 5112345678. Dashboard: https://telemetry.internal/dashboards/ff-model-v2-canary

ben: canary 1% stable after 3m. moving to 5% in 2m. :thumbsup:

carla: telemetry looks clean — no 5xx spike, p95 unchanged. proceeding to 25%. :eyes:

dinesh: Rollback script staged and verified. Quick checklist in case of abort:
- run rollback commands above
- pin traffic to v1
- open incident channel and tag #oncall
- revert infra kvcache toggle if we changed it

ben: at 25% now. running regen smoke tests and sampling logs for prompt set "regression_prompt_set_v3".

carla: A/B eval looks good. hallucination rate within threshold. watch throttles on embedding service (it can cascade).

alice: If all good at 25%, proceed to 100% over next 10m. Support/docs: standby for a short note linking to rollback playbook.

ben: hitting 100% now. No anomalies observed across metrics or smoke tests. Marking deploy complete. :tada:

dinesh: Pinned v2 as active in the routing table and left a 6h pin expiry. I'll unpin after 6h if no regressions.

alice: Thanks team. I'll archive this thread and post release notes to #release-notes. If anything goes sideways, open a postmortem.

carla: Small follow-up: add a telemetry alert for model-version drift into the standard post-deploy checklist so we don't miss it next time.
